description:
Apply orphan-safe middle-span trajectory compression to a message history. The safe-boundary planner protects the first-turn anchors and the most-recent tail turns, then compresses only the middle span via an LLM summariser using the agent/compaction prompt. Returns the reassembled history plus echoed span indices for caller logging, or the input untouched with the planner's reason when no safe middle span exists.

Billable: consumes credits from the caller's wallet (token-metered).
name: compressTrajectorySafe
